items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active (Derwin James inactive hamstring).
items.implication: Start with bigger dock per Levitan; monitor snaps.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans officially active after late-week practice optimism on ribs (Kittle noted fractured ribs suck).
items.implication: Startable but bigger dock; reduces Deebo stream appeal.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson questionable to return (ankle) then left stadium in protective boot; Rapoport day-to-day to be monitored/treated this week.
items.why: Ankle injury scrambling; Huntley in; boot postgame.
items.implication: Monitor practice Week 5 closely; Huntley stream if out.
items.opportunity: Ravens offense limited without Lamar dual-threat; Flowers/Henry usage shifts.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase ruled OUT due to concussion after facemask + hard hit; evaluated then out for remainder vs Jaguars.
items.why: Concussion protocol after nasty hit; walked off then locker room.
items.implication: Sit ROS short-term; protocol timeline TBD for Week 5.
items.opportunity: Major target bump to Tee Higgins + other CIN WRs.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley downgraded to OUT with hamstring injury after pulling up early vs Rams.
items.why: Hamstring; limped off, ruled out first half.
items.implication: Sit immediately; check Week 5 status vs former team Giants.
items.opportunity: Primary carries to Tank Bigsby + Shipley; goal-line/third-down shift.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: EXPECTED TO PLAY Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears; GTD/OPTIMISTIC Mike Evans; NOT EXPECTED Jalen Coker, Terry McLaurin, Keenan Allen; Tyson Bagent starting.
items.why: Core Sunday expected/GTD/not expected summary aligned with Schefter/Rap.
items.implication: Start Nacua/Flowers/McConkey; fade McLaurin/Coker/Allen; monitor Evans.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full workloads projected for expected group.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially inactive vs Colts in London.
items.implication: Sit McLaurin; look to other WAS pass catchers or streamers.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining WAS WRs/TEs.

items.text: Chiefs WR Tyquan Thornton dislocated ankle (put back in place); carted off after career day 111 yds 2 TDs; out indefinitely, full eval + second opinion morning; made plane, good spirits.
items.why: Gruesome lower leg; carted; reduced and plane.
items.implication: Long-term out; KC WR depth hit with Rice doubtful too.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Lamar (ankle), Chase (concussion)/Higgins (adductor), Saquon (hamstring)/Bigsby, Rice (hamstring)/Thornton (ankle), McConkey (foot agg), DJ Moore (shoulder), Monangai (thumb), Pat Bryant (ankle), others.
items.why: Comprehensive list of Sunday exits/aggravations for next week.
items.implication: Priority waiver/handcuff and Week 5 status checks.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries reverse if unexpected returns; depth chart shifts.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore aggravated shoulder injury today; not considered long-term issue as of right now.
items.implication: Monitor Week 5; possible limited or sit short-term.
items.opportunity: BUF WR targets may shift if limited.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker inactive (as ETR not expected).
items.implication: Tetairoa McMillan and others see more targets.
items.opportunity: Increased CAR WR snaps/routes to McMillan group.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice downgraded to doubtful (hamstring).
items.implication: Likely sit; check final status; Xavier Worthy/others elevated.

items.text: Add Lamar to Saquon, Chase, DJ Moore and Mariota among players leaving games early.
items.implication: Immediate sit/beneficiary pivot for fantasy; usage shifts mid-slate.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players: RT Lane Johnson (personal Q), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion).
items.why: Schefter Johnson personal Q; prior Smith/Goedert/Baun issues.
items.implication: PHI offense depleted; Hurts/ remaining skill impacted; reverse if unexpectedly in.
items.opportunity: Targets to remaining WRs; OL impact on run/pass.

items.text: Small dock only on Puka Nacua (groin) as Rams intend no workload limit per Schefter; tinier dock Flowers (hamstring) no hard pitch count; bigger docks Ladd McConkey (foot/ribs) and Mike Evans (ribs). Projecting Sadiq in little dock.
items.why: Schefter no-limit Nacua; Fowler no pitch count Flowers; bigger injury concerns McConkey/Evans.
items.implication: Nacua near full value upgrade; McConkey/Evans more cautious starts.
items.opportunity: Nacua snaps/routes unrestricted; McConkey possible limited routes/carries.

items.text: Sigh on Jeremiyah Love snap management: frustrated with limited snaps (e.g. 11 second half close game), ankle maintenance but more whole-body management to finish season; coaches putting better physical options in.
items.why: Postgame comments on frustration/management not injury per se.
items.implication: Lower floor/ceiling while managed; handcuff/backup value rises.

items.text: Packers ruled out star LB Edgerrin Cooper Achilles; LaFleur 'not good,' belief torn season-ending.
items.why: Ruled out; coach comment + belief season-ending.
items.implication: GB defense hit; fantasy IDP/stream impact, less skill direct.

items.text: Not one but two Bhayshul Tuten touchdowns called back due to penalty.
items.why: Live observation two TDs wiped by flags.
items.implication: High opportunity but efficiency hit; still positive role signal.
